fusions.name: Unhurried Shove
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy push of the palm that deals 34 water damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Lazy Wave
fusions.desc: A slow wave of the hand sends water ahead, dealing 3 water damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long, with a 35% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Hurries
fusions.desc: You raise a palm and nothing hurries: every creature within 3 tiles is held in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbothered
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8 they all spend at once: you heal for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
